title: High School Girls with Books, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: This was taken while we lived at mothers - Chic + the girl next door - they were just leaving for high school last Sept - + Chic was 18 yrs. old Jan - 19 - 1950 Taken - Sept - 1949 801.
description: A clear 1949 black and white snapshot capturing two teenage girls standing on a sunlit suburban sidewalk, holding armfuls of schoolbooks as they depart for high school. Their attire showcases classic late-1940s American post-war style, featuring A-line and plaid skirts, tucked-in blouses, white ankle socks, and dark loafers. The handwritten note on the back provides intimate family history about 'Chic' and her neighbor.
